name: sync-pulse
_comment: Latency-calibration metronome for an external projection consumer.
The entire ring flashes bright white at exactly 1.000Hz with a hard
on/off edge (no fade/easing) so the eye can judge sync purely by the
flash onset. A full-opacity white 'solid' field (uniform, no spatial
phase -- every pixel identical) is gated by master.strobe in
period; depth=1.0 -> off phase is exactly 0, not just dim.
Do NOT post this to the live ring by default -- it is installed in
scenes/ so it can be activated later by name via POST /scene or the
